headline: Stock markets decline for 2nd day as IT shares lead losses - OrissaPOST
summary: The Sensex fell 249.70 points, or 0.33%, to 76,478.67 as IT, oil and gas and select bank shares led losses amid uncertainty over US-Iran talks in Doha.
why: The BSE Sensex is a 30-share benchmark index of the Bombay Stock Exchange, and the IT sector is a major component of Indian equity markets.
